mentions.name: The Card Caddie
mentions.description: A free credit card recommendation website and browser extension that tells users which card to use for purchases so they never miss rewards points, without requiring any personal credit card information.
mentions.problem: People miss out on credit card rewards points because they don't know which card to use for each purchase.
mentions.audience: Built for the author's own spending optimization; friends asked for it too.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on The Card Caddie (thecardcaddie.com) free credit card recommendation site + extension with no personal credit card info. Never miss a point again!

evidence.value: Working on The Card Caddie (thecardcaddie.com) free credit card recommendation site + extension with no personal credit card info. Never miss a point again!
